notes: Same category = 0.0, adjacent pair = 0.5, all others = 1.0. Adjacency reflects culinary functional similarity: herb/spice are both flavor modifiers, citrus/fruit are both plant-derived sweet/sour, protein/umami are both savory, fat/dairy are both lipid-rich, spirit/liqueur are both alcoholic, etc. Four additional pairs (chili+spice, seasoning+spice, bitters+liqueur, nut+fat) added for completeness based on culinary overlap present in the categories.json data.
